meta.title: 2025 same dates as the 2026 year to date
meta.label: paid Jan 1 to 09/28/2025, same dates as the 2026 year to date
meta.note: JSON keys named paid_2025... keep their historical names on every basis and hold this basis's dollars. No annualizing or extrapolation.

source: 2026 Budget Ordinance 6694-f78c vs Payments s4vu-giwb (paid Jan 1 to 09/28/2025, same dates as the 2026 year to date) + Contracts rsxa-ify5

definitions.budget_vendor_payable: 2026 appropriation lines whose account maps to a vendor-facing family (see families). Excludes personnel, pensions, debt, internal transfers, reserves, tax distributions.
definitions.paid_2025_vendor: payments of the chosen basis (see meta.label) resolved to the department, excluding pension / bank / tax / pass-through direct vouchers and payments on contracts missing from the Contracts dataset
definitions.covered_capped_by_family: sum over families of min(2026 budget, 2025 paid) so over-payment in one family cannot hide a gap in another. With a partial year basis, paid is NOT annualized, so coverage is understated

families.DELEGATE: Delegate agencies and program grants (0135 + 92xx program accounts)
families.FACILITY: Facility, equipment and street repair, maintenance services (0125, 0160-0163, 0176, 0188, 0526)
families.RENTAL: Rental of property and equipment, leases (0155, 0157, 0159)
families.LEGACY_UNTYPED: (payments only) contracts imported from legacy systems with no contract type

nonvendor_kinds.PERSONNEL: Salaries, wages, overtime, premiums (0000-0099 labor accounts)
nonvendor_kinds.DEBT: Debt service (interest, principal, notes, bond fees)
nonvendor_kinds.TRANSFER: Internal transfers and reimbursements between funds
nonvendor_kinds.PASSTHRU: Tax proceeds and contributions passed to the CTA (9189, 9205)
